statement: The P0309 intake requests low-positive-temperature crystalline Gibbs phases in three-dimensional Coulomb/Riesz regimes predicted by Lewin Section VI; the retrieved intake gives no universally quantified exponent range. The working specialization is a short-range s>3 grand-canonical DLR law periodic under a full-rank lattice and breaking continuous translations.
assumptions: This is a specialization, not a universal restatement of the underspecified intake.
Current openness UNKNOWN.
A renormalized long-range specification is required before claiming Coulomb or s<=3 results.
proof_or_counterexample: Recovered op-p0309 and at-p0309 exact entries; read Lewin Section VI. Conjecture 38 itself is zero-temperature. Historical status and a limited search are not current-status certificates.
remaining_gap: Original crystallization question unproved; exact universal scope is not supplied by the intake.

statement: For the three-dimensional nearest-neighbor harmonic torus with Hamiltonian (kappa/2)sum_{x,j}|u_{x+e_j}-u_x|^2+(h/2)sum_x|u_x|^2, beta,kappa,h>0 and N>=2, each component's variance is beta^{-1}g_N(h), with g_N(h)<=1/(hN^3)+13/(16kappa). Taking N to infinity before h to zero yields a finite variance. At fixed N the zero mode diverges as h to zero.
assumptions: Labelled centered Gaussian density on (R^3)^{(Z/NZ)^3}
The sum is over every positive coordinate edge as written
beta,kappa,h>0
proof_or_counterexample: Discrete Fourier diagonalization; sin(pi |n|/N)>=2|n|/N; max-norm shell has at most 24m^2+2 sites; sum at most 13/(16kappa); exact zero term 1/(hN^3); Riemann then monotone convergence with integrable |k|^-2 in dimension three.
remaining_gap: None for the reference lemma; no comparison to the Riesz gas has been proved.

statement: For the 3D nearest-neighbor Gaussian displacement field with beta,kappa>0 and reciprocal K!=0, volume before quadratic-pinning removal gives E exp(-iK.u_0)=exp[-|K|^2 G_3/(2 beta kappa)]>0. The shifted-lattice point process is simple, locally finite, lattice-periodic, and has a nonzero intensity Fourier coefficient. Its normalized Fourier average converges in L2 to that amplitude.
assumptions: Labelled harmonic reference field with covariance C(r)=(beta kappa)^(-1) integral exp(ikr)/omega(k) dk/(2pi)^3.
Lambda=A Z^3, A invertible, A^T K in 2pi Z^3.
No Riesz Gibbs membership is asserted.
proof_or_counterexample: Gaussian characteristic function, finite covariance, Riemann-Lebesgue, pair Cesaro averaging, and fundamental-cell tiling/Tonelli.
remaining_gap: No gap in the reference-model proof; transferring it to the nonlinear unlabelled Riesz gas is unproved.

statement: For a stationary matched/defect decomposition nu=sum_x J_x delta_(Ax+t+u_x)+eta with J in {0,1}, q_m=1-EJ_0, q_b=Eeta(F), delta=E[J_0 |u_0|^2], v=|det A| and reciprocal K, Re[exp(iK.t)v lambda_hat(K)]>=1-q_m-q_b-|K|^2 delta/2. A positive right side witnesses broken translations; a Gibbs conclusion additionally requires membership in a translation-covariant specification.
assumptions: Joint stationarity under integer label shifts; no independence.
eta is Lambda-periodic in law.
Finite q_b and delta.
lambda_hat(K)=v^(-1) integral_F exp(-iK.x) E nu(dx).
proof_or_counterexample: Exact tiling formula for the matched coefficient; absolute extra-mass bound q_b; cos z>=1-z^2/2.
remaining_gap: No gap in this conditional criterion; a Riesz matching/defect estimate and Gibbs membership are not supplied.

statement: The unlabelled short-range Riesz torus pressure with bounded source Psi=sum_{j=1}^3 cos(K_j.x) is even, real analytic at finite volume and convex, with p_N prime=E Q/(N^3 v), p_N double-prime=beta Var Q/(N^3 v), and factorial densities bounded by exp[k beta(mu+3|h|)].
assumptions: Finite s>3; beta>0; mu,h real; integer N>=1.
Lambda=A Z^3 and K_j=2pi A^(-T)e_j.
Nonnegative periodized Riesz pair energy.
The source is coupled as +beta h Q.
proof_or_counterexample: Poisson exponential domination, differentiated partition series, half-cell translation, and insertion bounds after deleting nonnegative interaction terms.
remaining_gap: No gap in the finite-volume lemma; it does not establish any thermodynamic pressure cusp.

statement: Assume P1, the equal-diagonal/equal-off-diagonal positive Gram condition on A, finite limiting pressure p near 0 and m=p right-prime(0)>0. Along a volume-first diagonal with pressure approximation error <=h_l/l, every selected local limit has three real equal intensity Fourier coefficients c_j>=m/3 and intensity translation-period group exactly A Z^3. If that limit is a zero-field Riesz DLR law, it is a periodic Gibbs law breaking continuous translations.
assumptions: s>3, beta>0 and finite mu.
A^T A has diagonal a, off-diagonal b, a-b>0 and a+2b>0.
p_N(h) converges to finite p(h) near zero.
m=p right-prime(0)>0.
Gibbs conclusion explicitly assumes zero-field DLR membership of the selected limit.
proof_or_counterexample: Convex secant bound plus diagonal selection; local moment and boundary-nullness controls pass cell expectations; inversion and basis permutations make three coefficients equal and real; nonzero reciprocal basis coefficients characterize the lattice period group.
remaining_gap: Application to P0309 needs a positive zero-source slope for the full gas and verification of zero-field DLR membership. No such slope has been proved.

statement: Positive response at nonzero pinning does not imply spontaneous order: V independent signs have pressure beta^(-1)log(2cosh(beta h)) and positive response at h>0 but zero right slope at 0. Conversely a collective two-state pressure (beta V)^(-1)log(2cosh(beta V h)) tends to |h| although every finite-volume slope at 0 is zero, and an arbitrary pinning diagonal can still destroy the selected response.
assumptions: Exact toy partition functions, not Riesz gases.
beta>0 and integer V>=1.
proof_or_counterexample: Differentiate both explicit pressures; use h_V=1/(beta V^2) versus h_V=1/sqrt(V).
remaining_gap: None for these exact counterexamples; no implication about existence of a Riesz cusp.

statement: For a trial T on the same unlabelled space with finite D(T||G_N,0) and E_T|Q|, p_N(h)-p_N(0)>=h E_TQ/V_N-D/(beta V_N). Under finite pressure convergence, trial families with liminf_N E_TQ/V_N>=q>0 and limsup_N D/(beta V_N h)<=epsilon(h) tending to zero give p right-prime(0)>=q. A sector Q>=qV_N of probability exp[-o(V_N)] is a sufficient special case.
assumptions: P1 zero-source law G_N,0 and source Q.
T absolutely continuous with finite relative entropy and finite E_T|Q|.
Limiting order and entropy-cost estimates are application hypotheses, not obtained estimates.
A deterministic lattice-position law is singular and inadmissible.
proof_or_counterexample: Expand D(T||G_N,h)>=0 with the exact source density; conditioning on a sector has entropy -log its probability.
remaining_gap: An ordered trial with entropy cost o(h) per volume has not been constructed for the full Riesz gas.
